# calckit

> calckit is a free online calculator suite — no account required, no ads.
> It covers everyday math, personal finance, and health calculations.

## What calckit does

- Mortgage, loan, and compound interest calculators
- Tax, salary, ROI, inflation, and savings calculators
- BMI, body fat, calorie, and TDEE calculators
- Tip, percentage, date, age, grade, and unit converters
- Currency exchange (live rates)
- All tools work instantly in the browser — no sign-up, no paywalls

## Who it's for

Anyone who needs a fast, accurate calculation without installing an app or
creating an account. Works on mobile and desktop.

## Website

https://calckit.yaro-labs.com

## Blog

https://calckit.yaro-labs.com/blog

Covers personal finance (mortgages, taxes, debt payoff, ROI), health (calories,
BMI, body fat), and everyday math (compound interest, unit conversion, tipping).

## Tool list

- /mortgage-calculator — Monthly mortgage payment & amortization
- /compound-interest-calculator — Investment growth over time
- /tax-calculator — 2025 US federal income tax estimate
- /salary-calculator — Annual salary to hourly, monthly, weekly
- /loan-calculator — Monthly payment on any loan
- /bmi-calculator — Body Mass Index & healthy weight range
- /calorie-calculator — Daily calorie needs by activity level
- /body-fat-calculator — Body fat % via US Navy formula
- /roi-calculator — Return on investment
- /savings-calculator — Savings goal timeline
- /debt-payoff-calculator — Debt avalanche & snowball payoff
- /inflation-calculator — Purchasing power over time
- /tip-calculator — Tip & bill-splitting
- /percentage-calculator — Percentage change, of, off
- /currency-converter — Live exchange rates
- /unit-converter — Length, weight, temperature, volume
- /discount-calculator — Sale price & savings
- /grade-calculator — GPA and weighted grades
- /age-calculator — Exact age & days until birthday
- /date-calculator — Days between dates
